texts.3:
The can's journey

Did you just have a drink from a can? Don't throw it into the regular trash! The can is made of aluminum, and it can be recycled.

Aluminum is produced from a rock called bauxite. To get the metal out of the rock, people dig huge mines in nature and use a great deal of electricity.

In recycling, used cans are collected, cleaned, crushed and melted in a very hot furnace. The liquid metal is made into new sheets, and new cans are made from them. Making a can from recycled metal saves most of the electricity needed to make a can from the rock.

Aluminum can be recycled again and again, and it does not lose its properties. Iron, copper and gold are recycled too. This way, less waste reaches the garbage dumps, and less nature is destroyed by digging.

So the next time you finish a drink, look for the recycling bin!
texts.22:
Does the Moon change shape?

One night we see a round, bright Moon in the sky, and a week later we see only half a circle. Does the Moon really change its shape? No! The Moon is a sphere, and it always stays a sphere.

The Moon does not make its own light. The Sun always lights up half of the Moon, and the Moon reflects that light back to us. The Moon travels around the Earth, so each night we see a different part of its lit side. The changes in shape that we see are called "the phases of the Moon."

When the Moon is between the Earth and the Sun, its lit side faces away from us, and we can hardly see it. This is the new moon. Little by little a crescent appears – a thin, lit strip – then a half moon, and after about two weeks, a full moon. Then the lit part gets smaller and smaller, until the next new moon.

A full cycle of the phases of the Moon lasts about 29½ days. That is why in the Hebrew calendar every month begins at the new moon (Rosh Chodesh), and in the middle of the month, on the 15th, the Moon is full. For example, on Seder night of Passover, 15 Nisan, the Moon is full.

questions.he: באיזה מופע של הירח יכול לקרות ליקוי ירח?
questions.q: In which phase of the Moon can a lunar eclipse happen?
questions.x: At the full moon, Earth is between the Sun and the Moon

questions.he: למה אסור להסתכל על ליקוי חמה בלי משקפיים מיוחדים?
questions.q: Why must you never watch a solar eclipse without special glasses?
questions.x: The strong sunlight can damage the eyes forever

questions.he: איזה צבע מקבל הירח לפעמים בליקוי ירח מלא?
questions.q: What color does the Moon sometimes turn in a total lunar eclipse?
questions.x: A little sunlight passes through the atmosphere and reddens it

questions.he: באיזה ליקוי מותר לצפות בעין בלי הגנה?
questions.q: Which eclipse is safe to watch without eye protection?
questions.x: The Moon doesn't dazzle – you can watch it safely

questions.he: הירח קטן מהשמש. איך הוא מסתיר אותה כולה?
questions.q: The Moon is smaller than the Sun. How can it hide all of it?
questions.x: Like a thumb near your eye hiding a faraway building

questions.he: מה גורם ליום וללילה?
questions.q: What causes day and night?
questions.x: Earth spins on its axis

questions.he: כמה שעות נמשך סיבוב אחד של הארץ סביב צירה?
questions.q: How many hours does one rotation of Earth on its axis take?
questions.x: One rotation = one full day = 24 hours

questions.he: איך נקראים יום ולילה ביחד?
questions.q: Daytime and nighttime together make up…
questions.x: Daytime plus nighttime = 24 hours

questions.he: כשבישראל צהריים, מה יש בצד השני של כדור הארץ?
questions.q: When it is noon in Israel, what is it on the other side of Earth?
questions.x: The side facing away from the Sun is dark

questions.he: באיזה כיוון השמש זורחת?
questions.q: In which direction does the Sun rise?
questions.x: The Sun rises in the east and sets in the west

questions.he: האם השמש באמת נעה סביבנו במשך היום?
questions.q: Does the Sun really move around us during the day?
questions.x: The Sun seems to move because we are spinning

questions.he: למה הצל שלנו קצר בצהריים?
questions.q: Why is our shadow short at noon?
questions.x: At noon the Sun is highest in the sky, so shadows are short

questions.he: לפי הגרף – באיזו שעה הצל הכי קצר?
questions.q: According to the graph, at what hour is the shadow shortest?
questions.x: The lowest point is at 12

questions.he: לפי הגרף – מה קורה לצל אחרי הצהריים?
questions.q: According to the graph, what happens to the shadow after noon?
questions.x: After 12 the points go up – the shadow gets longer

questions.he: מה יש בצד של כדור הארץ שפונה אל השמש?
questions.q: On the side of Earth that faces the Sun, it is…
questions.x: The lit side has daytime; the dark side has nighttime

questions.he: איך נקרא הזמן של הקפה אחת סביב השמש?
questions.q: What is the time of one orbit around the Sun called?
questions.x: One orbit = a year, about 365 days

questions.he: כמה ימים יש בשנה רגילה?
questions.q: How many days are in a regular year?
questions.x: That is how long one orbit around the Sun takes

questions.he: איזו תנועה קובעת את אורך החודש?
questions.q: Which motion sets the length of a month?
questions.x: The cycle of the Moon's phases takes about a month

questions.he: איזו תנועה יוצרת שנה?
questions.q: Which motion makes a year?
questions.x: One full orbit around the Sun – a year

questions.he: באיזו עונה הימים הכי ארוכים בישראל?
questions.q: In which season are the days longest in Israel?
questions.x: In summer the Sun rises high and shines for more hours

questions.he: איך נראית השמש בצהרי הקיץ, לעומת צהרי החורף?
questions.q: How does the Sun look at noon in summer, compared to noon in winter?
questions.x: In summer the Sun is high, and its rays are stronger

questions.he: מה גורם לעונות השנה?
questions.q: What causes the seasons?
questions.x: The axis is tilted, so the Sun's height changes

questions.he: לפי הטבלה – באיזה חודש יש הכי הרבה שעות אור?
questions.q: According to the table, which month has the most hours of daylight?
questions.x: 14 hours – the most daylight

questions.he: לפי הטבלה – באיזו עונה היום והלילה שווים בערך?
questions.q: According to the table, in which season are day and night about equal?
questions.x: In March: 12 hours of light and 12 hours of dark

questions.he: כשבישראל חורף, איזו עונה יש באוסטרליה?
questions.q: When it is winter in Israel, what season is it in Australia?
questions.x: In the southern half of Earth, the seasons are reversed

questions.he: מהו השלב הראשון בתכנון מוצר?
questions.q: What is the first step in designing a product?
questions.x: First you understand what problem needs to be solved

questions.he: מהו סדר השלבים הנכון?
questions.q: What is the correct order of the steps?
questions.x: Identify a need, come up with ideas, then build

questions.he: מה עושים מיד אחרי שבונים את המוצר?
questions.q: What do you do right after building the product?
questions.x: You check whether it meets the need

questions.he: הבדיקה הראתה שהמגדל נופל. מה עושים?
questions.q: The test showed that the tower falls over. What do you do?
questions.x: You improve it and test it again

questions.he: מהו אב-טיפוס?
questions.q: What is a prototype?
questions.x: You build a first model in order to test it

questions.he: למה כדאי להציע כמה רעיונות ולא רק אחד?
questions.q: Why is it worth suggesting several ideas, not just one?
questions.x: You compare ideas and choose the one that fits

questions.he: מה עושים בשלב התכנון?
questions.q: What do you do in the planning stage?
questions.x: You prepare a sketch and a list of materials and tools

questions.he: מהי "דרישה" של מוצר?
questions.q: What is a product "requirement"?
questions.x: For example: the bag must hold 5 kg

questions.he: איפה מחפשים מידע כשמתחילים לתכנן?
questions.q: Where do you look for information when you start planning?
questions.x: You learn from solutions that already exist

questions.he: מה משותף לכל המוצרים הטכנולוגיים?
questions.q: What do all technological products have in common?
questions.x: Every product is built to solve a problem

questions.he: נועה רוצה כלי ששומר על התה חם. מה הצורך?
questions.q: Noa wants something that keeps her tea hot. What is the need?
questions.x: The need: the tea should stay hot

questions.he: איזה חומר מתאים לבידוד הכלי של נועה?
questions.q: Which material is good for insulating Noa's container?
questions.x: Wool insulates against heat loss; metals conduct heat

questions.he: בבדיקה התה התקרר אחרי ⁦5⁩ דקות. מה השלב הבא?
questions.q: In the test, the tea cooled down after 5 minutes. What is the next step?
questions.x: The result isn't good – improve it and test again

questions.he: טמפרטורת התה אחרי ⁦20⁩ דקות. איזה כיסוי הכי טוב?
questions.q: Tea temperature after 20 minutes. Which cover works best?
questions.x: With wool the tea stayed hottest – 60°C

questions.he: לפי הטבלה – למה בדקו גם כוס בלי כיסוי?
questions.q: According to the table, why did they also test a cup with no cover?
questions.x: That shows how much each cover helped

questions.he: בנו גשר מקרטון. איך בודקים אותו?
questions.q: A bridge was built from cardboard. How do you test it?
questions.x: You check whether the bridge meets the requirement

questions.he: הדרישה: הגשר יחזיק ⁦1⁩ ק״ג. הוא החזיק ⁦2⁩ ק״ג. מה נכון?
questions.q: The bridge had to hold 1 kg. It held 2 kg. What is true?
questions.x: 2 kg is more than was required

questions.he: מה הכי חשוב לבדוק במגן לטלפון?
questions.q: What is most important to test in a phone case?
questions.x: The case is meant to protect the phone when it falls

questions.he: מה מסמנים בסרטוט של מוצר?
questions.q: What is marked on a sketch of a product?
questions.x: A sketch shows the shape, measurements and materials

questions.he: יואב בנה מתקן השקיה, אבל הצמח התייבש. מה המסקנה?
questions.q: Yoav built a watering device, but the plant dried up. What's the conclusion?
questions.x: The device didn't meet the requirement – it needs improving

questions.he: איזו תכונה משותפת לרוב המתכות?
questions.q: What property do most metals share?
questions.x: Metals conduct heat and electricity

questions.he: ברזל צבוע מחליד לאט יותר. למה?
questions.q: Painted iron rusts more slowly. Why?
questions.x: The paint blocks water and air

questions.he: למה לא בונים סירה מנייר?
questions.q: Why don't we build a boat out of paper?
questions.x: A boat's material must hold up in water

questions.he: מה חוסכים כשממחזרים מתכות?
questions.q: What do we save when we recycle metals?
questions.x: Less mining and less electricity

questions.he: חלב, גבינה ויוגורט עשירים במיוחד ב…
questions.q: Milk, cheese and yogurt are especially rich in…
questions.x: Dairy products are a source of calcium and protein

questions.he: איזה רכיב תזונה אינו נותן אנרגיה?
questions.q: Which of these nutrients does not provide energy?
questions.x: Water is essential, but it gives no energy

questions.he: איזו ארוחה מאוזנת יותר?
questions.q: Which meal is more balanced?
questions.x: Carbohydrate, protein and vegetables

questions.he: מה קורה למזון בוושט?
questions.q: What happens to food in the esophagus?
questions.x: The esophagus muscles push the food down

questions.he: איפה המזון מתערבב בחומצה ובמיצי עיכול?
questions.q: Where does food mix with acid and digestive juices?
questions.x: In the stomach, acid helps break down food

questions.he: מה תפקיד הריאות?
questions.q: What is the job of the lungs?
questions.x: And removing carbon dioxide from the body

questions.he: איזה הרגל שומר על הריאות?
questions.q: Which habit protects the lungs?
questions.x: Smoking harms the lungs and the whole body

questions.he: באיזו קרקע מים עומדים זמן רב?
questions.q: In which soil does water stay on top for a long time?
questions.x: Clay grains are tiny and tightly packed

questions.he: מה מעשיר את הקרקע במינרלים?
questions.q: What enriches the soil with minerals?
questions.x: Remains of plants and animals break down

questions.he: איזה סלע כהה נפוץ ברמת הגולן?
questions.q: Which dark rock is common in the Golan Heights?
questions.x: The Golan formed from the lava of volcanoes

questions.he: איזה כוכב לכת הוא השני מהשמש?
questions.q: Which planet is second from the Sun?
questions.x: Mercury, and then Venus

questions.he: איך נקרא שלב הירח שבתמונה?
questions.q: What is the Moon phase in the picture called?
questions.x: Half of the circle is lit

questions.he: כמה פעמים מסתובב כדור הארץ סביב צירו בשבוע?
questions.q: How many times does Earth spin on its axis in a week?
questions.x: One spin every day – 7 in a week

questions.he: כמה פעמים מקיף כדור הארץ את השמש בשנה?
questions.q: How many times does Earth orbit the Sun in a year?
questions.x: One full orbit every year

questions.he: מהו השלב שבין הרעיונות לבנייה?
questions.q: Which stage comes between the ideas and the building?
questions.x: You choose an idea and plan it

questions.he: הבדיקה הראתה שהמוצר עונה על הצורך. מה זה אומר?
questions.q: The test showed that the product meets the need. What does that mean?
questions.x: The product does what it is supposed to do
